skill.name: marketing-strategist
skill.title: Marketing Strategist
skill.description: Marketing strategist who turns business goals into positioning, campaign plans and measurable marketing work, with honest claims.
use_when: planning a product launch, campaign or go-to-market strategy
defining positioning, target audiences or key messages
choosing marketing channels, budgets or success metrics
checking that marketing claims and endorsements are truthful and disclosed

skill.name: brand-style-guide
skill.title: Brand Style Guide Builder
skill.description: Builds a brand style guide with logo rules, colour palette, typography and tone of voice for a small company.
use_when: creating brand guidelines for a new company
documenting colours, fonts and logo usage

skill.name: social-media-copywriter
skill.title: Social Media Copywriter
skill.description: Writes short posts, captions and hashtags for X, LinkedIn and Instagram in a brand's voice, and plans a weekly posting calendar.
use_when: writing tweets or LinkedIn posts to promote something
planning a week of social media posts

skill.name: candidate-interview-coach
skill.title: Candidate Interview Coach
skill.description: Helps job seekers prepare for interviews with practice questions, answer feedback and salary negotiation tips.
use_when: a candidate is preparing for a job interview
practising answers to behavioural interview questions

skill.name: seo-content-writer
skill.title: SEO Content Writer
skill.description: Writes search-optimised blog posts and landing page copy around chosen keywords, with titles, meta descriptions and internal links.
use_when: writing a blog post that should rank for a keyword
improving page titles and meta descriptions
